method.candidate_path: manual gate translation plus Qulacs statevector
counterexamples: mutate one RZ sign and require rejection
swap one CZ endpoint ordering and require rejection when observable
omit final-layout inversion and require rejection
perturb one SX matrix entry and require rejection

gate_translation.cz: explicit diag(1,1,1,-1) in verified little-endian target order
gate_translation.rz: explicit diag(exp(-i*theta/2),exp(i*theta/2)); do not use SDK rotation convention
gate_translation.sx: explicit Qiskit-definition complex128 matrix; do not use SDK alias

method.probe_source: reuse the four immutable QOS-AUDIT-010B19 preparations

nonclaims: four probes do not prove full operator equivalence
independent simulation is not hardware fidelity evidence
not live calibration, provider execution, energy, cost, or advantage evidence
not GPU, CPU, NPU, RAM, VRAM, or storage replacement evidence
